strings.zh: 马老师,我在健身房给精灵练级,{NEWLINE}把精灵的颈椎给练坏了。{CLEAR}马老师您能不能教教我混元功法,{CLEAR}帮助治疗一下我这两只精灵啊。
strings.en: Master Ma, I was grinding levels for my{NEWLINE}Pokémon at the gym and wrecked their{CLEAR}necks. Master Ma, could you teach me{CLEAR}your Hunyuan kung fu and help heal{CLEAR}these two Pokémon of mine?
strings.notes: Hunyuan Dojo: the Ma Baoguo meme scene (#0–#29) acted out with Pokémon; meme lines kept as close to the well-known wording as possible.

strings.zh: 可以啊。{NEWLINE}出来吧,怪力。
strings.en: Sure. Come on out, Machamp.

strings.zh: 『卧薪尝胆』
strings.en: “Struggle for vengeance”

strings.zh: 『重度骨折』
strings.en: “A severe fracture”
strings.notes: US 0533/3 | RV027: meaning: 重度骨折 is a severe fracture, not a complicated one (D-1882)

strings.zh: 你在健身房练死级不好用,{NEWLINE}今天给你看看{CLEAR}我的口袋妖怪练的混元功法,{CLEAR}这个绝对好用。
strings.en: Brute-force level grinding at the gym is{NEWLINE}no use. Today I’ll show you the Hunyuan{CLEAR}kung fu my Pokémon trains. Now that is{CLEAR}definitely useful.
strings.notes: | RV027: meaning: 练死级 puns on 死劲: keep the level-grinding joke (D-1882)

strings.zh: 怪力『Ma——cham！
strings.en: Machamp: Ma-cham!

strings.zh: 马老师我不认同！{SCROLL}口袋妖怪对战,{NEWLINE}最关键的就是等级。{CLEAR}您怎么能说练级不好用呢！
strings.en: Master Ma, I don’t agree!{SCROLL}In Pokémon battles, level is what{NEWLINE}matters most. How can you say grinding{CLEAR}levels is no use?

strings.zh: 小朋友,你两个精灵{NEWLINE}来折我这一只怪力的手指试试。
strings.en: Young friend, have your two Pokémon{NEWLINE}try to bend back one finger of my one{CLEAR}Machamp.

strings.zh: 试试就试试。{SCROLL}沙瓦郎、艾比郎,{NEWLINE}去给我折怪力的手指头。
strings.en: Fine, let’s try it.{SCROLL}Hitmonlee, Hitmonchan, go bend back{NEWLINE}Machamp’s finger.

strings.zh: 口袋妖怪对战又不是比折指头,{NEWLINE}折不折得动指头什么的,{CLEAR}在实战中也没什么用啊。
strings.en: Pokémon battles aren’t a finger-bending{NEWLINE}contest. Whether you can bend a finger{CLEAR}or not doesn’t matter in a real fight.

strings.zh: 我这个有用,这是化劲。{NEWLINE}传统口袋妖怪对战是讲化劲的,{CLEAR}四两拨千金。{SCROLL}400多公金的卡比兽{NEWLINE}都握不动我怪力的手指。
strings.en: Mine is useful. This is redirecting force.{NEWLINE}Traditional Pokémon battling is all about{CLEAR}redirecting force: four ounces{CLEAR}deflecting a thousand pounds.{SCROLL}A 400-plus-kilo Snorlax can’t even{NEWLINE}budge my Machamp’s finger.

strings.zh: 那咱们就在实战中试试啊。
strings.en: Then let’s try it in a real fight.
But...

strings.zh: 沙瓦郎！飞膝踢！
strings.en: Hitmonlee! High Jump Kick!

strings.zh: 继续！回旋踢！
strings.en: Keep going! Rolling Kick!

strings.zh: 艾比郎！音速拳！
strings.en: Hitmonchan! Mach Punch!

strings.zh: 怪力！守住！
strings.en: Machamp! Protect!

strings.zh: 怪力,趁现在！{NEWLINE}使用近身拳！
strings.en: Machamp, now! Close Combat!

strings.zh: 嘿嘿,按传统功夫的点到为止{NEWLINE}你已经输了。
strings.en: Heh heh. By the stop-on-contact rule{NEWLINE}of traditional kung fu, you’ve already{CLEAR}lost.

strings.zh: 居然被你先打到了我面部……
strings.en: You actually landed the first hit on my{NEWLINE}face...
strings.notes: | RV027: omission: 居然 surprise restored

strings.zh: 好了怪力,收拳不打了。
strings.en: All right, Machamp. Pull your punches.{NEWLINE}We’re done.

strings.zh: 艾比郎！音速拳！
strings.en: Hitmonchan! Mach Punch!

strings.zh: 大意了,没有闪……
strings.en: I was careless. I didn’t dodge...

strings.zh: 沙瓦郎、艾比郎,乘胜追击！
strings.en: Hitmonlee, Hitmonchan, press the{NEWLINE}attack!

strings.zh: 停、停！{NEWLINE}小伙子你不讲武德！你不懂！
strings.en: Stop, stop! Young man, you have no{NEWLINE}martial ethics! You don’t understand!

strings.zh: 马老师对不起、对不起,{NEWLINE}我不懂规矩。{CLEAR}我这都是乱打的。
strings.en: Master Ma, I’m sorry, I’m sorry. I{NEWLINE}don’t know the rules. I was just flailing{CLEAR}around.

strings.zh: 你可不是乱打的啊,{NEWLINE}飞膝踢、回旋踢、音速拳……{CLEAR}你分明就是训练有素。
strings.en: You weren’t just flailing around! High{NEWLINE}Jump Kick, Rolling Kick, Mach Punch...{CLEAR}You’re clearly well trained.

strings.zh: 是,是,我确实在湛蓝道馆{NEWLINE}练过三四年。
strings.en: Yes, yes. I did train at the Cianwood{NEWLINE}Gym for three or four years.

strings.zh: 看来你是有备而来啊,{NEWLINE}真是不讲武德！{CLEAR}来,骗！{CLEAR}来,偷袭！{CLEAR}我这69级的老怪力。{CLEAR}这好吗？{CLEAR}这不好！{CLEAR}我劝你这位年轻人好自为之,{CLEAR}好好反思,{CLEAR}以后不要再犯这样的聪明,{CLEAR}小聪明啊。{SCROLL}口袋妖怪训练家要以和为贵,{NEWLINE}要讲武德,不要搞窝里斗。
strings.en: So you came prepared. You really have{NEWLINE}no martial ethics! You came to deceive!{CLEAR}You came to sneak-attack my old Lv. 69{CLEAR}Machamp! Is this good? This is not{CLEAR}good! I advise you, young man, to{CLEAR}behave yourself and reflect carefully.{CLEAR}Never again commit such cleverness...{CLEAR}petty cleverness.{SCROLL}Pokémon Trainers should value harmony,{NEWLINE}uphold martial ethics, and not fight{CLEAR}among themselves.
strings.notes: | RV027: meaning: 来,骗！来,偷袭！ accuses the youth of coming to deceive/ambush, not imperatives; 你这位年轻人 addresses him (D-1882)

strings.zh: 行吧,行吧,反正是我赢了,{NEWLINE}随你怎么说吧。{CLEAR}咱们走,沙瓦郎、艾比郎。
strings.en: Fine, fine. I won anyway. Say whatever{NEWLINE}you want. Let’s go, Hitmonlee,{CLEAR}Hitmonchan.

strings.zh: 我现在要请马老师{NEWLINE}给我的口袋妖怪们治治病,{CLEAR}你要是没有什么急事的话{CLEAR}就请先上旁边看着,{CLEAR}让我先来请教马老师吧。
strings.en: I’m about to ask Master Ma to treat my{NEWLINE}Pokémon. If you’re not in a hurry,{CLEAR}please stand aside and watch, and let{CLEAR}me consult Master Ma first.

strings.zh: 朋友你好,{NEWLINE}我是混元形意太极门的掌门人马保锅,{CLEAR}是格斗系口袋妖怪的专家。{CLEAR}如果你想向我挑战,{CLEAR}就先打败我的徒弟们吧。
strings.en: Hello, friend. I am Ma Baoguo,{NEWLINE}Grandmaster of the Hunyuan Xingyi Taiji{CLEAR}School and an expert in Fighting-type{CLEAR}Pokémon. If you wish to challenge me,{CLEAR}first defeat my disciples.

strings.zh: 我现在要请马老师{NEWLINE}给我的口袋妖怪们治治病,{CLEAR}你要是没有什么急事的话{CLEAR}就请先上旁边看着,{CLEAR}让我先来请教马老师吧。
strings.en: I’m about to ask Master Ma to treat my{NEWLINE}Pokémon. If you’re not in a hurry,{CLEAR}please stand aside and watch, and let{CLEAR}me consult Master Ma first.

strings.zh: 嘘,别出声。{NEWLINE}马老师要展示他的混元功法了。
strings.en: Shh, quiet. Master Ma is about to{NEWLINE}demonstrate his Hunyuan kung fu.

strings.zh: 精灵球里装着一只精灵。
strings.en: There’s a Pokémon inside the Poké Ball.

strings.zh: 闪电鞭是混元形意太极门的绝技,{NEWLINE}你想见识见识吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: The Lightning Whip is the secret{NEWLINE}technique of the Hunyuan Xingyi Taiji{CLEAR}School. Want to see it for yourself?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 我的闪电五连鞭只能打到第2鞭,{NEWLINE}要是我能像马老师那样打出5连鞭,{CLEAR}到第3个鞭的时候你就肯定倒了。
strings.en: I can only get up to the second strike{NEWLINE}of my Lightning Five-Whip. If I could{CLEAR}land all five like Master Ma, you’d have{CLEAR}been down by the third whip for sure.

strings.zh: 接化发是传统口袋妖怪对战的核心,{NEWLINE}你想试试我的接化发绝技吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Receive, Transform, Release is the core{NEWLINE}of traditional Pokémon battling. Want to{CLEAR}try my Receive, Transform, Release{CLEAR}technique?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 唉,你打过来的技能我接不住啊,{NEWLINE}我到底是接手没练好呢{CLEAR}还是化劲没练好呢？
strings.en: Sigh. I can’t receive the moves you{NEWLINE}throw at me. Is my receiving no good, or{CLEAR}is my transforming no good?

strings.zh: 马老师虽然没杀过人,{NEWLINE}但他当年可是一周杀一头小山猪的,{CLEAR}你想看看我从马老师那学来的{CLEAR}杀猪神技吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Master Ma may never have killed a man,{NEWLINE}but in his day he killed a Swinub a week.{CLEAR}Want to see the godlike pig-killing{CLEAR}technique I learned from Master Ma?{SCROLL}
strings.notes: | RV027: omission: 神技 godlike technique restored

strings.zh: 格斗系技能虽然能克制小山猪,{NEWLINE}但似乎没法克制你啊。
strings.en: Fighting moves may beat Swinub, but{NEWLINE}they don’t seem to beat you.

strings.zh: 我一直在研究{NEWLINE}马老师和伽勒尔冠军实打的录像,{CLEAR}并且已经从中悟出了不少东西。{CLEAR}你能跟我来场对战印证一下吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: I’ve been studying the video of Master{NEWLINE}Ma’s real fight with the Galar Champion,{CLEAR}and I’ve learned a lot from it. Will you{CLEAR}battle me so I can put it to the test?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 总有人说{NEWLINE}马老师和伽勒尔冠军皮特•呃梨,{CLEAR}他们之间的对战是假打,{CLEAR}其实那是马老师把对手给封死了,{CLEAR}让皮特的精灵一招都使不出来,{CLEAR}所以外行人看起来才会觉得假。
strings.en: People keep saying Master Ma’s fight{NEWLINE}with the Galar Champion, Pete... er,{CLEAR}Leon, was staged. The truth is Master{CLEAR}Ma shut his opponent down completely.{CLEAR}Pete’s Pokémon couldn’t use a single{CLEAR}move, so to amateurs it looked fake.
strings.notes: 皮特•呃梨: pun on Pete (the meme’s British opponent) and a Galar Champion; rendered ‘Pete... er, Leon’ (Leon uses Charizard, cf. #58).

strings.zh: 外面有很多人嫉妒马老师的成就,{NEWLINE}于是就编造了各种关于马老师的谣言。{CLEAR}你也像他们那样怀疑马老师吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Lots of people out there are jealous of{NEWLINE}Master Ma’s achievements, so they make{CLEAR}up all kinds of rumors about him. Do you{CLEAR}doubt Master Ma like they do?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 虽然你赢了,{NEWLINE}但是我们混元形意太极门{CLEAR}不是他们说的那样！
strings.en: You may have won, but our Hunyuan{NEWLINE}Xingyi Taiji School is not what they say{CLEAR}it is!

strings.zh: 我的这些师兄弟一个个的{NEWLINE}都以为自己得了马老师的真传,{CLEAR}其实他们什么都没学到,{CLEAR}能悟到马老师精髓的只有我而已。{CLEAR}你想跟我比划比划试试吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Every one of my fellow disciples thinks{NEWLINE}he’s inherited Master Ma’s true{CLEAR}teachings. Actually, none of them{CLEAR}learned a thing. I’m the only one who{CLEAR}grasped Master Ma’s essence. Want to{CLEAR}spar with me and see?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 当我发现马老师手里的怪力不是怪力,{NEWLINE}而是百变怪的时候,{CLEAR}我就明白了{CLEAR}马老师为什么能当我们的老师了。{SCROLL}我决定回到家乡以后{NEWLINE}就用从马老师这里学到的东西{CLEAR}去开自己的道馆。{CLEAR}名字我都想好了,{CLEAR}就叫作精武炎方太极！
strings.en: When I found out that Master Ma’s{NEWLINE}Machamp wasn’t a Machamp at all, but a{CLEAR}Ditto, I finally understood why Master{CLEAR}Ma gets to be our teacher.{SCROLL}When I go back home, I’m going to use{NEWLINE}what I learned from Master Ma to open{CLEAR}my own dojo. I’ve already picked the{CLEAR}name: Jingwu Yanfang Taiji!

strings.zh: 这就要向我挑战吗？{NEWLINE}你都没发现{CLEAR}我是这么多弟子中修为最高的一个吗？{SCROLL}想跟我对战的话,{NEWLINE}就先打败我的这些师兄弟们再说吧。
strings.en: You want to challenge me already?{NEWLINE}Haven’t you noticed that I’m the most{CLEAR}accomplished of all these disciples?{SCROLL}If you want to battle me, first defeat{NEWLINE}my fellow disciples.

strings.zh: 看来我门下的弟子,{NEWLINE}已无一人是你的对手了。{CLEAR}好,既然如此,{CLEAR}就让我来会会你吧！
strings.en: It seems none of my disciples is a match{NEWLINE}for you anymore. Very well. In that{CLEAR}case, I shall face you myself!

strings.zh: 看来你是个很有天赋的{NEWLINE}格斗系精灵训练家啊,{CLEAR}通过跟我的对战想必你也学到了很多。{CLEAR}作为跟我学习过的证明,{CLEAR}我旁边这两个精灵球里的精灵,{CLEAR}你选一个作为你的伙伴吧！
strings.en: You seem to be a very talented{NEWLINE}Fighting-type Trainer. You must have{CLEAR}learned a lot from our battle. As proof{CLEAR}that you studied with me, choose one of{CLEAR}the Pokémon in the two Poké Balls beside{CLEAR}me as your partner!
strings.notes: #49 player wins / #50 Ma stops the battle (lose branch); both give Hitmonlee (#80) or Hitmonchan (#85)

strings.zh: 停！停！可以了。{SCROLL}再打下去,{NEWLINE}你的精灵就要被我精灵的{CLEAR}三维立体混元劲给打伤了。{CLEAR}不过总的来说你还是很有天赋的,{CLEAR}作为跟我学习过的证明,{CLEAR}我旁边这两个精灵球里的精灵,{CLEAR}你选一个拿走吧！
strings.en: Stop! Stop! That’s enough.{SCROLL}Any more, and your Pokémon would be{NEWLINE}injured by my Pokémon’s{CLEAR}three-dimensional Hunyuan force. Still,{CLEAR}all in all, you’re very talented. As{CLEAR}proof that you studied with me, choose{CLEAR}one of the Pokémon in the two Poké Balls{CLEAR}beside me and take it!

strings.zh: 年轻人,你想继续{NEWLINE}在我混元形意太极门学习吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Young one, do you wish to continue{NEWLINE}studying at my Hunyuan Xingyi Taiji{CLEAR}School?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 在我这里学的东西{NEWLINE}保证你受益终生。
strings.en: What you learn here is guaranteed to{NEWLINE}benefit you for life.

strings.zh: 请教我闪电鞭绝技！
strings.en: Teach me the Lightning Whip!

strings.zh: 请教我接、化、发绝技！
strings.en: Receive, Transform, Release!
strings.notes: menu width fix (follow-up 1): was 'Teach me Receive, Transform, Release!'

strings.zh: 请教我一点点人生的经验！
strings.en: Teach me a little life experience!

strings.zh: 算了,先不学了。
strings.en: Not now.

strings.zh: 好,今天我就跟你探讨一下{NEWLINE}怎样让口袋妖怪打出松活弹抖闪电鞭。{SCROLL}要打出松活弹抖闪电鞭{NEWLINE}就要做到三点。{CLEAR}一,要做到全身真正的放松。{CLEAR}关节要放松,{CLEAR}关节周围的经络要适当地用气。{CLEAR}这里面该松的松,该紧的紧,{CLEAR}松中有紧,紧中有松。{CLEAR}这个问题非常复杂,我就不多说了。{CLEAR}在「商机形意拳练法打法实践」中{CLEAR}有详细的解释。{CLEAR}二,要练好内功。{CLEAR}只有练好内功,{CLEAR}你才能丹田发力,{CLEAR}打出松活弹抖劲。{CLEAR}要学会下合上砍,上合下砍。{CLEAR}三,要用三维立体混元劲{CLEAR}才能打出松活弹抖闪电鞭。{CLEAR}你看我这一鞭的劲,{CLEAR}你看,都是三维的啊。{SCROLL}听了这么多理论的知识,{NEWLINE}你要让你的精灵也学一下{CLEAR}我这松活弹抖闪电鞭吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Good. Today I’ll discuss with you how a{NEWLINE}Pokémon can strike with the Loose,{CLEAR}Lively, Springy, Shaky Lightning Whip.{SCROLL}To strike with the Loose, Lively,{NEWLINE}Springy, Shaky Lightning Whip, you must{CLEAR}do three things.{SCROLL}One: the whole body must truly relax.{NEWLINE}Relax the joints, and use qi properly in{CLEAR}the meridians around them. Loosen what{CLEAR}should be loose, tighten what should be{CLEAR}tight. Tight within loose, loose within{CLEAR}tight. It’s very complex, so I won’t{CLEAR}say more. It’s all explained in ‘Xingyi{CLEAR}Fist for Business: Training and Fighting{CLEAR}in Practice.’{SCROLL}Two: master your inner strength. Only{NEWLINE}then can you generate power from the{CLEAR}dantian and strike with loose, lively,{CLEAR}springy, shaky force. Learn to close{CLEAR}below and chop above, close above and{CLEAR}chop below.{SCROLL}Three: you must use three-dimensional{NEWLINE}Hunyuan force to strike with the Loose,{CLEAR}Lively, Springy, Shaky Lightning Whip.{CLEAR}Look at the force in my whip. See? It’s{CLEAR}all three-dimensional.{SCROLL}After so much theory, do you want your{NEWLINE}Pokémon to learn my Loose, Lively,{CLEAR}Springy, Shaky Lightning Whip?{SCROLL}
strings.notes: 松活弹抖闪电鞭 / 接化发: dialogue-only technique names from the Ma Baoguo meme; which real move the tutor teaches isn't visible. D-1480: shortened to fit the 1,024-unit field message buffer (minimal edits, rechecked against zh).

strings.zh: 好,我现在就教教你,{NEWLINE}为什么我的传统口袋妖怪格斗技巧{CLEAR}比精灵联盟的对战技巧要好得多。{SCROLL}我曾经在伽勒尔地区{NEWLINE}与那里的口袋妖怪对战冠军{CLEAR}——皮特•呃梨进行实战,{CLEAR}在这场实战中{CLEAR}我就用了一个接化发的动作。{CLEAR}就是他的喷火龙出手了,{CLEAR}我的精灵接住以后打了它,{CLEAR}就是这个动作。{CLEAR}传统口袋妖怪对战的核心打法,{CLEAR}就是要打接化发,四两拨千金。{CLEAR}所谓的接化发,{CLEAR}就是接手、化劲、发劲,{CLEAR}这是传统口袋妖怪对战独有的。{CLEAR}接——！{CLEAR}化——！{CLEAR}发——！{CLEAR}如果年轻人你没有学会接化发,{CLEAR}就不要过高地估计自己的对战水平。{CLEAR}说你能代表传统口袋妖怪对战技巧,{CLEAR}你是代表不了的。{SCROLL}那么你要让你的精灵{NEWLINE}学一下接化发绝技吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Good. Now I’ll teach you why my{NEWLINE}traditional Pokémon fighting techniques{CLEAR}are far better than the{CLEAR}Pokémon League’s battle techniques.{SCROLL}I once had a real fight in the Galar{NEWLINE}region with their Pokémon Champion,{CLEAR}Pete... er, Leon. In that fight, I used{CLEAR}a Receive, Transform, Release move. His{CLEAR}Charizard attacked, my Pokémon{CLEAR}received it, then struck it. That move{CLEAR}right there. The core of traditional{CLEAR}Pokémon battling is Receive, Transform,{CLEAR}Release: four ounces deflecting a{CLEAR}thousand pounds. Receive, Transform,{CLEAR}Release means receiving the hand,{CLEAR}transforming the force, releasing the{CLEAR}force. It’s unique to traditional{CLEAR}Pokémon battling. Receive...!{CLEAR}Transform...! Release...! Young one, if{CLEAR}you haven’t learned Receive,{CLEAR}Transform, Release, don’t overestimate{CLEAR}your battling skills. You claim you{CLEAR}represent traditional Pokémon fighting{CLEAR}techniques? You don’t.{SCROLL}So, do you want your Pokémon to learn{NEWLINE}the Receive, Transform, Release{CLEAR}technique?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 人,生来就是要吃饭的。{NEWLINE}我作为一个{CLEAR}传统口袋妖怪对战技巧的专家,{CLEAR}我吃这碗饭,那是天然的没有选择的。{CLEAR}但是无论我吃的是哪口饭,{CLEAR}我都不会跟火箭队这种败类{CLEAR}一个锅里吃饭。{CLEAR}只有我脚下的这片土地好了,{CLEAR}我的饭才能吃得好,{CLEAR}要是让火箭队这种强盗{CLEAR}接管了这片土地,{CLEAR}那大家谁也别想吃好饭了,{CLEAR}这就是我的人生经验。
strings.en: Man is born to eat. As an expert in{NEWLINE}traditional Pokémon fighting techniques,{CLEAR}this is how I earn my rice. That’s{CLEAR}natural, I had no choice. But no matter{CLEAR}whose rice I eat, I will never eat from{CLEAR}the same pot as scum like Team Rocket.{CLEAR}Only if the land beneath my feet does{CLEAR}well can I eat well. If robbers like Team{CLEAR}Rocket took over this land, nobody{CLEAR}would get a decent meal. That is my life{CLEAR}experience.

strings.zh: 不跟我学习是你的损失。
strings.en: Not studying with me is your loss.

strings.zh: 跟我学习是要交学费的,{NEWLINE}你凑够10000元学费之后再来吧。
strings.en: Studying with me costs tuition. Come{NEWLINE}back when you’ve got the $10000 tuition{CLEAR}fee.
